hook: Hydraa gets *36* complaints on borewells, encroachments
hook_b: Hydraa gets *36* complaints on borewells, encroachments
tldr: Hydraa received 36 complaints on illegal borewells, encroachments and civic issues at Prajavani.

beats.what: Residents sought removal of illegal borewells near lakes, saying operators claim personal use but sell the water.
beats.why: Residents say groundwater extraction is depriving households of regular supply.
beats.care: If borewells near your lake are selling water, Hydraa Prajavani takes complaints at Budha Bhavan.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Commissioner AV Ranganath assigned the complaints for immediate action.

cards.q: Have you seen tankers filling from borewells near a lake?

qs: Who checks whether a 'personal use' borewell is selling water?

facts.t: Residents named *Thummalakunta Lake* in Keesara as being pumped and sold.

learn.t: FTL = Full Tank Level, the boundary of a lake at full capacity where building is barred.

watch: Whether Hydraa seizes or seals any borewells near Thummalakunta.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hydraa receives 36 complaints over illegal borewells

fact: Residents told Hydraa borewell water near lakes is *sold by tanker at night*.
twist: Complaints say Thummalakunta Lake in Keesara is being pumped through borewells and sold.
